full_page.content:
1933, December
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 162 Cont.
Dec. Carl Masse - 6 - infantile paralysis since baby ...... nurse ......
Leroy Blasz Kasski - 10 - 2 hours to live - 3 yrs. ago came to monastery got blessing - now serving Mass and O.K.
Mrs. Stock - 36 - Jewish, severe headaches now a number of yrs. enrolled for 50¢
Alphonse Dysarz - 30 - lung sagged. Thought for a time to be possessed etc.
6
Springer ... long time away from conf. - otherwise good man .... Little boy - 2 - intestinal trouble - had m Ray E. Parent - 36 - pneumonia - wife & 2 Mrs. Nina Mickey - 42 - 2 blood transfus.
Mr. Fr. Law - 38 - careless. . Alice Lewin - Elderly n. c. fears sight is going. Wanda - 17 - wants permission to go to convent.
Page 163 Dec. 6 Martha Beadersledt - 44 - 10 yr. sick.
Gert. Hennick - 36 - fears operation on stomach & intestines, feels better now but a little anxious.
Verea Besterci - 36 - cataract 7 yr.
Mrs. Rose Forrest - 55 - liver
Mrs. Eliz. Smith - 65 - Richmond, Mich. had cancer or .... got well ... now down again ....
7 Xavier Fish - 15 0 "cured of spinal trouble 13 yrs. ago, out of work 3 yrs ... last Saturday Nov. 2nd felt spinal trouble returning - enrol- led in Ser. Mass Ass'n reports going back to work To-night.
James Russell - 47 - drunk near always - wife heart-broken ..... he curses religion & C't.
Mother Juliana - postulants.
